reason: The hypothesis makes specific mechanistic claims about reduction kinetics, interdiffusion, and thermal control in noble metal HEA nanoparticle synthesis, but no cited evidence is provided to support any of these premises. Standard textbook knowledge does not cover the claimed narrow kinetic window or the system-specific behaviour of five or more noble metals.
premises: Precursor reduction speed and atomic interdiffusion speed can be balanced by a thermal profile
